name: named-date-points
dql: TABLE date(today), date(now), date(yesterday), date(tomorrow), date(sow), date(eow), date(som), date(eom), date(soy), date(eoy) FROM "a"
oqx: select _path, c0: date("today"), c1: date("now"), c2: date("yesterday"), c3: date("tomorrow"), c4: date("sow"), c5: date("eow"), c6: date("som"), c7: date("eom"), c8: date("soy"), c9: date("eoy") from docs where _path.startsWith("/a/") or _path == "/a.md"

name: iso-date-literals
oqx: select _path, c0: date("2026-10-15"), c1: date("2026-10"), c2: date("2026"), c3: date("2026-10-15T09:30"), c4: date("2026-10-15T09:30:00Z") from docs where _path.startsWith("/a/") or _path == "/a.md"

name: quoted-date-canonicalizes
oqx: select _path, c0: date("today"), c1: date("2026-10-15") from docs where _path.startsWith("/a/") or _path == "/a.md"

name: date-of-a-field-stays-a-call
oqx: select _path, c0: date(due), c1: date(_updated_at) from docs where _path.startsWith("/a/") or _path == "/a.md"

error.message: date(text, format): the date contract parses ISO text only (at line 1, column 7)

name: duration-literals
dql: TABLE dur(1 hour 30 minutes), dur(1h30m), dur(2 weeks, 3 days), dur(PT1H30M), dur(3 days) FROM "a"
oqx: select _path, c0: dur("1 hour 30 minutes"), c1: dur("1h30m"), c2: dur("2 weeks, 3 days"), c3: dur("PT1H30M"), c4: dur("3 days") from docs where _path.startsWith("/a/") or _path == "/a.md"

name: dur-of-a-field-stays-a-call
oqx: select _path, c0: dur(day), c1: dur(elapsed) from docs where _path.startsWith("/a/") or _path == "/a.md"

name: date-plus-duration
dql: TABLE date(today) + dur(1 day), dur(1 day) + date(today), due + dur(1 week) FROM "a"
oqx: select _path, c0: date("today").plus("1 day"), c1: date("today").plus("1 day"), c2: due.plus("1 week") from docs where _path.startsWith("/a/") or _path == "/a.md"
warnings: `field + duration` read as field.plus(duration): the field is taken for a date

name: date-minus-duration
dql: TABLE date(today) - dur(7 days), file.mtime - dur(1 hour) FROM "a"
oqx: select _path, c0: date("today").minus("7 days"), c1: _updated_at.minus("1 hour") from docs where _path.startsWith("/a/") or _path == "/a.md"

name: date-minus-date-is-until
dql: TABLE date(today) - file.mtime, due - date(today), date(today) - due FROM "a"
oqx: select _path, c0: _updated_at.until(date("today")), c1: date("today").until(date(due)), c2: date(due).until(date("today")) from docs where _path.startsWith("/a/") or _path == "/a.md"
warnings: `date - field` read as date(field).until(date): the field is taken for a date, the result a duration

name: duration-arithmetic-stays-numeric
dql: TABLE dur(2 hours) + dur(30 minutes), dur(1 day) * 2, dur(1 week) - dur(1 day) FROM "a"
oqx: select _path, c0: dur("2 hours") + dur("30 minutes"), c1: dur("1 day") * 2, c2: dur("1 week") - dur("1 day") from docs where _path.startsWith("/a/") or _path == "/a.md"

name: date-compared-with-a-field-wraps-the-field
dql: LIST WHERE due < date(today) & date(today) <= deadline & file.mtime >= date(2026-01-01)
oqx: select _path from docs where date(due) < date("today") and date("today") <= date(deadline) and _updated_at >= date("2026-01-01")

name: date-members
dql: TABLE file.mtime.year, file.mtime.month, file.mtime.day, file.mtime.weekday, file.mtime.hour, file.mtime.minute, file.mtime.second, date(due).date FROM "a"
oqx: select _path, c0: _updated_at.year(), c1: _updated_at.month(), c2: _updated_at.day(), c3: _updated_at.weekday(), c4: _updated_at.hour(), c5: _updated_at.minute(), c6: _updated_at.second(), c7: date(due).date() from docs where _path.startsWith("/a/") or _path == "/a.md"

error.message: date.week: the date contract has year/month/day/weekday/hour/minute/second/date only (at line 1, column 7)
duration.hours: a duration is a number of seconds in OQX; its calendar components are not available (dur_text()/dur_iso() format it) (at line 1, column 7)

name: dateformat-and-striptime
dql: TABLE dateformat(file.mtime, "yyyy-MM-dd"), dateformat(due, "MMMM"), striptime(file.mtime), striptime(due) FROM "a"
oqx: select _path, c0: _updated_at.format("yyyy-MM-dd"), c1: date(due).format("MMMM"), c2: _updated_at.date(), c3: date(due).date() from docs where _path.startsWith("/a/") or _path == "/a.md"
warnings: dateformat pattern "MMMM": only yyyy MM dd HH mm ss MMM EEE are tokens in OQX; other letters print literally

error.message: durationformat(): the duration contract has dur_text()/dur_iso() but no pattern formatter (at line 1, column 7)
date * x: a date only adds or subtracts (at line 1, column 7)
date() / dur(): the server's surface has no dates (surface < 4.8); capabilities.dates is false

name: duration-literal-shift-is-the-calendar-string
dql: TABLE date(2026-01-31) + dur(1 month), file.mtime - dur(1 year), due + dur(elapsed) FROM "a"
oqx: select _path, c0: date("2026-01-31").plus("1 month"), c1: _updated_at.minus("1 year"), c2: due.plus(dur(elapsed)) from docs where _path.startsWith("/a/") or _path == "/a.md"
warnings: `field + duration` read as field.plus(duration): the field is taken for a date

name: dateformat-luxon-tokens-warn
oqx: select _path, c0: _updated_at.format("EEEE, MMMM d") from docs where _path.startsWith("/a/") or _path == "/a.md"
warnings: dateformat pattern "EEEE, MMMM d": only yyyy MM dd HH mm ss MMM EEE are tokens in OQX; other letters print literally
